system.description: Also at 6th level, raising your voice is unnecessary. Your presence, scars and eyes do the talking. Your stare makes others shift in their shoes. Others find it difficult to even push you or your allies socially. When a non-hostile creature would attempt to make a Charisma or Wisdom check against you or your allies, you gain 1 Social Carnage (Max 1), which expires after 1 minute. When you or your allies would respond with a Charisma or Wisdom check of your own, you can spend this Social Carnage giving advantage on the roll.
